2: use ruff_macros::{derive_message_formats, ViolationMetadata};
3: use ruff_python_ast::{self as ast, Expr};
4: use ruff_python_trivia::{SimpleTokenKind, SimpleTokenizer};

10: /// ## What it does
11: /// Checks for unnecessary dictionary unpacking operators (`**`).
12: ///
13: /// ## Why is this bad?
14: /// Unpacking a dictionary into another dictionary is redundant. The unpacking
15: /// operator can be removed, making the code more readable.
16: ///
17: /// ## Example
18: /// ```python
19: /// foo = {"A": 1, "B": 2}
20: /// bar = {**foo, **{"C": 3}}
21: /// ```
22: ///
23: /// Use instead:
24: /// ```python
25: /// foo = {"A": 1, "B": 2}
26: /// bar = {**foo, "C": 3}
27: /// ```
28: ///
29: /// ## References
30: /// - [Python documentation: Dictionary displays](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/expressions.html#dictionary-displays)
31: #[derive(ViolationMetadata)]
32: pub(crate) struct UnnecessarySpread;
33: 
34: impl Violation for UnnecessarySpread {
35:     const FIX_AVAILABILITY: FixAvailability = FixAvailability::Sometimes;
36: 
37:     #[derive_message_formats]
38:     fn message(&self) -> String {
39:         "Unnecessary spread `**`".to_string()
40:     }
41: 
42:     fn fix_title(&self) -> Option<String> {
43:         Some("Remove unnecessary dict".to_string())
44:     }
45: }
46: 
47: /// PIE800
48: pub(crate) fn unnecessary_spread(checker: &mut Checker, dict: &ast::ExprDict) {
49:     // The first "end" is the start of the dictionary, immediately following the open bracket.
50:     let mut prev_end = dict.start() + TextSize::from(1);
51:     for ast::DictItem { key, value } in dict {
52:         if key.is_none() {
53:             // We only care about when the key is None which indicates a spread `**`
54:             // inside a dict.
55:             if let Expr::Dict(inner) = value {
56:                 let mut diagnostic = Diagnostic::new(UnnecessarySpread, value.range());
57:                 if let Some(fix) = checker.locator().unnecessary_spread_fix(inner, prev_end) {
58:                     diagnostic.set_fix(fix);
59:                 }
60:                 checker.diagnostics.push(diagnostic);
61:             }
62:         }
63:         prev_end = value.end();
64:     }
65: }
66: 
67: impl Locator<'_> {
68:     /// Generate a [`Fix`] to remove an unnecessary dictionary spread.
69:     fn unnecessary_spread_fix(&self, dict: &ast::ExprDict, prev_end: TextSize) -> Option<Fix> {
70:         let source = self.contents();
71:         let dict_range = dict.range;
72:         let dict_start = dict_range.start();
73:         let dict_end = dict_range.end();
74:         debug_assert!(dict_end >= dict_start);
75: 
76:         // Find the `**` token preceding the spread.
77:         let doublestar = SimpleTokenizer::starts_at(prev_end, source)
78:             .find(|tok| matches!(tok.kind(), SimpleTokenKind::DoubleStar))?;
79: 
80:         if doublestar.range.len() != TextSize::from(2) {
81:             return None;
82:         }
83: 
84:         let push_deletion = |edits: &mut Vec<Edit>, range: TextRange| {
85:             let edit = Edit::range_deletion(range);
86:             if edit.content().is_none()
87:                 && edits
88:                     .iter()
89:                     .all(|existing| !existing.range().contains_range(edit.range()))
90:             {
91:                 edits.push(edit);
92:             }
93:         };
94: 
95:         if let Some(last_item) = dict.items.last() {
96:             // Ex) `**{a: 1, b: 2}`
97:             let last_value = &last_item.value;
98:             let value_range = last_value.range();
99:             let scan_from = match last_item.key.as_ref() {
100:                 Some(key) => key.range().end().max(value_range.end()),
101:                 None => value_range.end(),
102:             };
103: 
104:             let mut edits = vec![];
105:             for tok in SimpleTokenizer::starts_at(scan_from, source).skip_trivia() {
106:                 match tok.kind() {
107:                     SimpleTokenKind::Comma => {
108:                         push_deletion(&mut edits, tok.range());
109:                     }
110:                     SimpleTokenKind::RBrace => {
111:                         push_deletion(&mut edits, tok.range());
112:                         break;
113:                     }
114:                     _ => {}
115:                 }
116:             }
117:             Some(Fix::safe_edits(
118:                 // Delete the first `**{`
119:                 Edit::deletion(doublestar.start(), dict_start + TextSize::from(1)),
120:                 // Delete the trailing `}`
121:                 edits,
122:             ))
123:         } else {
124:             // Ex) `**{}`
125:             Some(Fix::safe_edit(Edit::deletion(doublestar.start(), dict_end)))
126:         }
127:     }
128: }
